wardrobe.description: Soft bedtime pajamas suitable for sleeping in a new room; simple, comfortable, and consistent across all pages.
Tiny mustard-yellow crossbody satchel with a simple flap, scaled to the chameleon; it can catch briefly on the blanket and later rest beside the chameleon on the shelf.

anchors.description: Unfamiliar green walls, clean and recently painted.
A simple bed with a blanket pulled high, positioned as the emotional safety point of the room.
Brown cardboard moving boxes of different sizes, some stacked high.
A small box near the bed containing familiar objects from the old home.
A bare window without curtains, with a wooden sill at child height.
A small shelf where the chameleon can curl up beside the satchel.

locations.description: A newly moved-into child's bedroom at night. The room feels too large and unfamiliar, with green walls, a cold floor, many brown moving boxes, a bed with a blanket, an empty window, and a small shelf. The space gradually becomes warmer once the blue cloth from the old curtain is placed on the window sill.
locations.lighting: Soft nighttime interior lighting with gentle shadows; slightly cool and echoey at first, becoming warmer and calmer near the window by the end.
locations.name: The new bedroom
locations.topology: Single-room layout: the bed-and-shelf area sits along one wall; the tall stack of boxes creates a shadowed corner across the room; a small box is beside the bed; the empty window and wooden sill are reached by crossing the cold floor from the bed area. All zones are connected within the same bedroom.
